title: i18n: read-only booleans render "Yes"/"No" in every locale, and the home greeting joins with an ASCII ", " and "." under zh-CN
body:
Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — localization | 缺项 | P2

Split by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` from objectui#11672 (the 2026-10-06 console dogfood sweep, showcase, framework `ce577ec4`), items 16 (booleans, greeting). Re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing: still live, with no open duplicate. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/fields/src/widgets/BooleanField.tsx` (about `:82`), `FormulaField.tsx` (about `:32`), `lookupColumnDisplay.tsx` (about `:243`) and `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` (about `:429`–`:434`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the words and punctuation are hard-coded English.

## What happens

Under zh-CN, record-detail booleans render "Yes" / "No" (邮箱已验证 Yes), and the home greeting reads "夜深了, Dev Admin." with an ASCII comma and period.

## Done when

- The boolean labels and the greeting's joiners come from translation keys present in every locale.
- **Pins:** zh-CN renders 是/否 (or the existing key's value) and full-width punctuation, and en is unchanged.
